foundationTasks.title: Repository initialized with React, Vite, TS, Tailwind, and MapLibre
Data model, shared types, and banned language checks created
Architecture, API contracts, and workstreams documented
Mobile-first route skeleton & features created under /src/features
Mock scenarios, spatial stub, and task-status CLI tools created
PS_FIT.md and JUDGE_QA.md created with Ameya single-ownership
Geometry gate structure (GATE_STATUS.json, check-gate.mjs) created & wired

tasks.title: Select Target Site & Authoritative Source Geometry (Go/No-Go Gate)
tasks.description: Acquire official GeoJSON boundary for Shivneri Fort with source documentation, test points, and update GATE_STATUS.json to PASSED.
tasks.definitionOfDone: GATE_STATUS.json marked PASSED with source URL, capture date, 3 verified test coordinates, and passing npm run gate:check.

tasks.title: Implement Point-in-Polygon & Distance-to-Boundary Engine
tasks.description: Implement Turf.js geodesic point-in-polygon and distance calculations without using circular center points.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Turf.js functions calculate exact distances in meters for polygon boundary perimeters with unit tests passing.

tasks.title: Implement Accuracy-Circle Overlap & Uncertainty Evaluator
tasks.description: Implement boundary uncertainty evaluation: if distanceToBoundary <= gpsAccuracyMeters, return LOCATION_UNCERTAIN.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Spatial evaluator downgrades classification to LOCATION_UNCERTAIN whenever GPS accuracy circle intersects boundary.

tasks.title: Deterministic Spatial Test Suite with 4 Demo Scenarios
tasks.description: Write automated Vitest tests verifying the 4 benchmark test points (Inside, Outside, Near-Edge, Degraded GPS).
tasks.definitionOfDone: All 4 scenarios produce 100% predictable, explainable outputs in automated test runner.

tasks.title: Finalize Observation Categories & Neutral Prompt Guidelines
tasks.description: Review and approve the 7 visible-change categories and neutral phrasing rules in /docs/PRODUCT_CONTRACT.md.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Observation categories and prompt questions confirmed to contain zero accusatory or legal terminology.

tasks.title: Reviewer Status Transitions & Audit Timeline Rules
tasks.description: Define allowable reviewer actions (Additional Info, Field Verification, Refer, Close) and reason taxonomies.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Audit timeline rules and state transition validation matrix fully documented.

tasks.title: Reviewer Evidence Packet Schema & Legal Limitation Disclaimer
tasks.description: Finalize the exact section breakdown and disclaimer notices for exportable Reviewer Evidence Packets.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Packet template approved by Ameya with full 3-part statement separation.

tasks.title: Mobile Field Capture Studio & GPS Accuracy HUD
tasks.description: Build touch-optimized mobile capture screen with 7 category buttons, camera upload, neutral description input, and live accuracy HUD.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Field capture form operates cleanly on mobile viewports with simulated or hardware GPS accuracy meter.

tasks.title: MapLibre Vector Map & Boundary Overlay Component
tasks.description: Integrate MapLibre GL with open vector tile styling, site geometry polygon, observation point, and GPS uncertainty circle.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Map renders Shivneri boundary and accuracy circle without relying on proprietary paid tile keys.

tasks.title: Case Detail & Change Ledger Timeline Component
tasks.description: Build append-only timeline interface showing dated events, observation details, uncertainty pills, and review history.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Timeline visually renders chronological events with distinct status tags and non-alarming UI palette.

tasks.title: Append-Only Event Dispatcher & Store
tasks.description: Build event storage engine ensuring edits create new dated events rather than overwriting historical records.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Store records observation, location capture, spatial classification, and review events immutably.

tasks.title: Case ID Generator & Provenance Metadata Store
tasks.description: Implement standard case ID sequencing (e.g. HP-MH-2026-XXXX) and metadata formatting.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Generates unique, sortable case tracking codes linked to site records.

tasks.title: Reviewer Assessment Console & Action Modal
tasks.description: Build reviewer queue filtering by status and modal allowing reviewers to record action notes and state changes.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Reviewers can filter cases, enter action rationales, and update case status in the Change Ledger.

tasks.title: Exportable Reviewer Evidence Packet Generator
tasks.description: Build printable HTML/PDF reviewer dossier featuring map snapshot, photo evidence, SHA-256 seal, and audit timeline.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Standardized, print-ready evidence dossier renders cleanly in browser print dialog.

tasks.title: End-to-End 12-Step Workflow Integration Test
tasks.description: Validate complete user journey from Site Context -> Field Capture -> Spatial Engine -> Change Ledger -> Reviewer Action -> Packet.
tasks.definitionOfDone: All 12 steps of the user journey execute without runtime errors across all 4 benchmark test scenarios.

tasks.title: Offline Resilience & Airplane Mode Demonstration
tasks.description: Validate that the demo runs 100% reliably in airplane mode without dropping field drafts or throwing network exceptions.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Field observation successfully saved locally while offline and synchronized upon reconnecting.

tasks.title: Record 3-Minute SIH Demo Video & Presentation Deck
tasks.description: Record 3-minute jury demo video following the exact 5-scene blueprint script with live Near-Boundary trust moment.
tasks.definitionOfDone: 3-minute MP4 video recorded demonstrating live uncertainty calculation and reviewer packet export.
